blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte on Tuesday took his oath as witness to the impeachment trial of his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte. The House prosecution panel called for the presentation of Baste Duterte, particularly on the Davao City government’s transactions with GenCorp Industries Inc. – a company supposedly among the business interests of the vice president. Previous witnesses claimed that 15 food service contracts worth P34,216,900 were awarded by the Davao City government to GenCorp sometime between June 2022 to June 2026.
